editorial.blurb: A beloved Skokie institution serving excellent kosher comfort food with generous portions, killer burgers, and the kind of genuine warmth that keeps people coming back for decades.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Bay-Ken Burger or Buddy Burger with their fries—reviewers call them some of the best in the country—and don't skip the popcorn BBQ chicken if you're in the mood for something different.

topDishes.note: A greasy, perfectly messy classic Chicago burger that hits every time
Called a masterpiece by reviewers, served with delicious fries
Worth the price and worth the trip back
